purpose: One-family mathematics H1 pre-pilot for the frozen-policy augmented-mixture estimator.

stages.name: acquire
stages.objective: Freeze the DAPO mathematics prompt frame, verifier, current checkpoint, stale checkpoint rule, and contamination boundaries.
inputs: Approved entries and exact revisions from experiments/public_source_registry.json
Frozen rl section of experiments/pilot_preregistration.json
Verified preflight data/content manifests, passing content-readiness ledger, and retained role-file hashes from hash-pinned local JSONL exports
Versioned mathematics prompt identifiers with known target masses
Current-policy, stale-policy, tokenizer, and decoder revisions
Public mathematics verifier source hash
checks: Prompt support is finite, normalized, and reconstructible
Stable row, raw-content, and normalized-content hashes are recorded before partitioning
The frozen PII, secret, and lexical near-duplicate gates report no retained-content finding; passing is not represented as semantic or privacy clearance
The acquisition manifest embeds the preflight manifest and retained role-file hashes
Licenses and verifier requirements are recorded

stages.name: process
stages.objective: Normalize verifier outcomes and validate exact sampler/scorer probability agreement.
inputs: acquire/data_manifest.json
Temperature-softmax decoder specification and maximum response length
Deterministic allowed-vocabulary rule with no top-k, top-p, repetition, minimum-length, or forced-token processor
Parser, timeout, sandbox-error, EOS, and truncation reward rules
Frozen experiments/content_gates.json, its hash-bound ledger, and a reviewed hidden-evaluator semantic-overlap audit
Frozen experiments/overlap_projection_contract.json plus reviewed prompt and protected-answer field inventories
For more than 4096 retained rows, a frozen reviewed exact engine and hash-bound external-overlap shards covering every unordered pair
checks: Every retained duplicate cluster is assigned wholly to nuisance-fit, alpha-selection, or confirmation

The record-pair external audit remains blocking for a multi-field export; a reviewed successor must cover the full cross-record segment-pair space and independently reproduce every qualifying segment pair
The trajectory schema embeds the passing content-readiness ledger hash and accounts for every scanned record with an included partition or explicit exclusion reason
Prompt and protected verifier/reference fields reproduce from a reviewed multi-field projection attestation; generated or null inventories cannot clear real execution
Sampler frequencies agree with scored masses in finite-vocabulary conformance tests
Current and stale sampler/scorer pairs agree on normalized masses, EOS-at-limit, and truncation semantics
Prompt and sequence mixture masses normalize in high precision
No verifier outcome is retried or silently dropped

stages.name: build
stages.objective: Construct policy, stale actor, frozen reward/length predictors, prompt baseline, and adaptive proposal.
inputs: process/trajectory_schema.json
Exact finite-law Gate 0 oracle, implemented omitted-prompt-ratio and clipped-weight fault injections, and 1e-12 identity tolerance
Frozen alpha grid, per-alpha stratum counts, and proposal support floor
Projection, nuisance-training, and stale-KL configurations
checks: Nuisance and proposal models use only prior-iteration disjoint data
Current and behavior scorers share tokenizer, masks, and decoder semantics
Policy and nuisance tensor hashes are frozen before each audit
Gate 0 reproduces target gradient, mixture normalization, weight bound, and implemented-weight bias identities
Base-versus-decoder scoring, focal-nuisance fitting, and policy-data-reuse injections remain blocking pending validators before Phase A

stages.name: train
stages.objective: Audit projected bias/variance at frozen policies and freeze alpha on data disjoint from confirmation.
inputs: build/model_manifest.json
Two mutually independent large current-policy reference samples for each of D_select and D_confirm
Disjoint nuisance-fit, alpha-selection, and untouched confirmation prompt partitions
Matched 64-trajectory replications and measured cost ledger
checks: Every theorem-facing trajectory is generated after iteration choices freeze and has use_count one
Every theorem-facing draw reaches a scored outcome; an infrastructure-failed replication is retained but cannot enter a success-conditioned estimator claim
Each successful current, stale, R1, and R2 row declares the exact projected-term semantics and every attempted row retains allocated accelerator-seconds
Projected terms are intermediate only; real execution remains blocked until U, h, w, A, and B are reconstructed from raw hash-bound trajectory fields
The numerical mixture-weight bound and source-specific ESS are checked
The exploratory alpha-allocation coupling is logged as a design restriction rather than an unbiasedness requirement
Generated-token, verifier-call, and added-scoring counters retain aborted candidates

stages.name: evaluate
stages.objective: Aggregate untouched-confirmation gradient bias, variance, MSE-times-cost, and deliberate ratio fault injections.
inputs: train/trajectory_ledger.jsonl
Frozen projection, confirmation replications, independent R1/R2 reference pairs, and seed pairing
Pinned NumPy 2.5.3 PCG64 bootstrap engine, chunk size 32, and nearest-rank interval rule
Omitted-prompt-ratio and clipped-weight fault injections
checks: Projected MSE uses the cross-reference product (g_hat - R1)^T(g_hat - R2)
aggregate_rl_estimator.py reconstructs mean(A_current)+(1-alpha)*mean(B_stale), cell cost, the selection argmin, and untouched-confirmation MSE directly from the hash-bound trajectory ledger
The same aggregator independently resamples candidate replications, R1 trajectories, and R2 trajectories and exactly reproduces each reported percentile interval from the frozen seed schedule

Chunked exact multinomial sufficient statistics reproduce the full 64-coordinate, 250-replication, 2048-reference-row, 2000-bootstrap selection-law fixture without materializing resampled trajectory tensors
Selection retains negative raw cross-MSE but uses max(raw MSE,0) times cost; untouched confirmation contains the selected cell and alpha=1 control plus their contrast
Reference-generation accelerator cost remains in the summary separately rather than disappearing into a shared constant
Selection targets D_select and confirmation targets the separately normalized D_confirm
The selected alpha is evaluated once on untouched confirmation replications
Any infrastructure failure blocks estimator-claim eligibility instead of producing a success-conditioned MSE; eligibility is distinct from the H1 estimate and result
Every seed, parser failure, support failure, and negative result is retained
